messages:
emily: Noticed a partner log bundle in our ingestion S3 containing what looks like Vault transit ciphertexts plus partial oauth tokens. Looks like they zipped raw logs before redaction. Need quick sweep + rotation plan.

tom: Can you paste a redacted example line (no secrets)?

emily: example (redacted): `2026-03-24T03:12:44Z ingest INFO {\"path\":\"/partner/a/log.gz\", \"payload\":{\"transit_ct\":\"v3:CgQAXXX...\", \"partial_token\":\"pa_12***yz\"}}`

priya: Triage items: 1) Quarantine affected objects to gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/ 2) Suspend partner service account keys 3) Remove decrypt rights for partner principal on staging/prod KMS keys 4) Kick Vault token revocations for partner-derived tokens 5) Start search for any other exposures.

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-INC-2026-1302 (partner-log-credential-exposure).

vault-bot: Vault audit shows 23 failed decrypt attempts for partner principal since 2026-03-24T03:00Z.

tom: Running commands now: 
```
# copy to quarantine and make private
gsutil cp gs://partner-bucket/2026/03/24/*.gz gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/ && gsutil acl ch -u redwood-sec-quarantine-service-account:R gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/**
# disable SA key
 gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEYID --iam-account=partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# temporarily remove kms decrypt binding
 gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:partner-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

emily: Also ask partner to confirm they rotated any tokens they control and to stop sending raw logs. I'll draft comms now.

priya: I'll enable KMS audit logs export to BigQuery for 180 days so we can query decrypt operations. Also will run `vault token revoke -prefix partner-*` after we confirm which tokens exist.

ops-bot: Quarantine copy completed. 5 objects moved. ACLs set to private.

tom: Found 2 more buckets with similar gz logs. Copying them now.

priya: For Vault: reduce TTL for partner auth role to 5m and enable `token_revocation` in the role. We'll also enforce that partner-created tokens are one-time use. I'll file a follow-up change.

emily: Owners: tom -> quarantine + SA key disable, priya -> Vault + audit sinks + role TTL changes, emily -> partner comms + incident triage. Check-in in 20.

vault-bot: Suggested command: `vault list auth/partner/creds || true` to enumerate.

priya: After quarantine, run a pattern-based grep on bucket contents for ciphertext headers like `v[0-9]+:` and partial token patterns to find any missed exposures. I'll prepare a small GCS job.

tom: grep scan results: detected 14 additional gzip files referencing `v3:` and partial tokens. Quarantined those too.

emily: Incident note: no production customer data appears in the leaked logs, but still treat as sensitive.

priya: Post-incident items: - enforce upload-side redaction in partner contract + CI check - add automated alert when logs contain `transit_ct` or `partial_token` patterns - require partners to use structured logging and a sanitizer library - add one-click revoke + rotate playbook for partner integrations

emily: I'll add those to the security backlog and link to SEC-INC-2026-1302. Closing thread; further updates in the incident channel.
